theme: An open day, with holiday logistics quietly running late.
greeting: The calendar is nearly empty today, Dan — a one-hour NACD program at 1 and otherwise yours. The pressure isn't in the schedule; it's in two holiday bookings that get harder every week they wait.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV is the one that bites
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 Todoist task, overdue since Sep 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out — book a refundable one now and fix the dates later.

needsAttention.title: December break still needs a destination
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by Sept 30 and book-by Oct 15 dates have both passed. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year — pick domestic vs. international and shortlist three, per your own p2 note.

flagged.title: ICGN wants you on a Plenary 7 planning call
flagged.detail: Claudia Rossetti at ICGN wrote about a planning call for Plenary 7 at the Autumn Conference; the thread is still unanswered.

flagged.title: Valoris / FinCity call moved to Nov 5
flagged.detail: An updated invitation puts the Valoris Stewardship Catalysts <> IMC/FinCity call on Thu Nov 5, 7–8 AM ET.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and alerts — a LinkedIn job alert, Patreon, an Evite, and sailing and Redbubble sales.

acts.line: Nothing sits on the calendar before noon — the morning is entirely yours.
A single one-hour NACD director program is the day's only fixed point.
The evening is clear — the natural window to settle the overdue holiday bookings.
